title: Oenone
summary: Raleigh names Oenone in the History of the World (1617).
description: Named in Raleigh's History of the World (1617). Oenone, who confessed to Paris that she had beene rauished by Apollo. No yeere of the World was taken for her. Display only. No tier 1–4 chronology dates this person, so there is no sort year.

sorting_basis.note: No tier gives a birth year. Raleigh is display-only.

free_source_links.locator: Book II, Part I, Chapter XXIV, §. V, sig. 349a–349b
